items.explanation: Marks 経済のニュース as the direct object of the verb 読みます (that which is read).

items.jp: 名前を間違えて恥ずかしかったです

translation.pt-BR: Errei o nome e fiquei com vergonha.
translation.en: I got the name wrong and was embarrassed.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 名前 as what was confused/got wrong by the verb 間違える.

items.jp: ドアを強く押した

translation.pt-BR: Empurrei a porta com força.
translation.en: I pushed the door hard.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ドア (door) as the direct object that receives the action of pushing. It is the standard particle for the target of a transitive verb like 押す.

items.jp: 台所にマッチを置いた

translation.pt-BR: Deixei os fósforos na cozinha.
translation.en: I left the matches in the kitchen.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks マッチ as that which undergoes the action of putting (置く).

items.jp: 本を読んでそれから寝た

translation.pt-BR: Li um livro e depois fui dormir.
translation.en: I read a book and then went to sleep.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 本 as what is read, the direct target of 読む.

items.jp: 熱いから気をつけて

translation.pt-BR: Cuidado, que está quente.
translation.en: Careful, it's hot.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 気 as the object of つける within the fixed expression 気をつける (to take care / pay attention).
tokens: object (part of the expression 気をつける)

items.jp: 白い靴下を二つ買いました

translation.pt-BR: Comprei duas meias brancas.
translation.en: I bought two white socks.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 靴下 as the object bought, the target of the verb 買う.

items.jp: 彼に伝言を伝えてください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, dê um recado a ele.
translation.en: Please give him a message.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 伝言 as that which one is asked to convey, the direct object of 伝える.

items.jp: テレビを台の上に置いた

translation.pt-BR: Coloquei a televisão em cima da estante.
translation.en: I put the television on top of the shelf.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks テレビ as what receives the action of 'placing': it is the thing that was put down.

items.jp: 薬を飲んだ　すると頭が痛くなくなった

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e, então, a dor de cabeça passou.
translation.en: I took the medicine, and then my headache went away.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 薬 (the medicine) as that which receives the action of 飲む (to take).

items.jp: 日曜日に祖父母を訪ねた

translation.pt-BR: No domingo visitei meus avós.
translation.en: On Sunday I visited my grandparents.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: を marks 祖父母 as the direct target of the verb 訪ねる (who was visited).

items.jp: 夜に好きな番組を見る

translation.pt-BR: À noite eu assisto aos programas de que gosto.
translation.en: At night I watch the programs I like.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 好きな番組 as the direct object of the verb 見る (what is watched).
